recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5827; any future formulary availability or catalogue-status requirement should be addressed as a separate Pharmacy/Formulary decision.
issue_request: FHIR-5827 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy request asking whether Medication should have a status code; the final Jira trail says status would be added with active, inactive, and entered-in-error while deferring formulary-specific availability semantics.
initial_application: No FHIR-5827-tagged implementation commit was found. Historical commit 1854c20643b58916f4f9e00d51f54e942579f38b added Medication.status and its MedicationStatus code list to the old Medication spreadsheet source as part of the same status change family, and FHIR-12392 cites that patch for the same status addition.
additional_context: Medication is active and approved in source/fhir.ini. Current XML source carries forward Medication.status as 0..1 code with required Medication Status binding and the non-formulary caveat. Related FHIR-12392 is already audited on the combined branch, and later FHIR-32482 already changed the value definitions to record-currentness wording.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current core source already satisfies FHIR-5827 and no stale current text or community evidence requires a new source edit.

related_jiras.note: Requested the same Medication.status active/inactive/entered-in-error surface and search support; already represented on the combined branch by an audit commit.
Later Published issue refined Medication status definitions to record-currentness wording; already fixed on the combined branch and preserved here.
Earlier issue documented pre-status guidance that Medication lacked entered-in-error; it was superseded by the later status addition.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive Pharmacy issue asking whether Medication should have status and recording active, inactive, and entered-in-error as the accepted status values.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the seed request and the boundary that formulary availability semantics were not part of the accepted Medication.status scope.

evidence_items.summary: Medication is listed as an active resource, has a current resource code, and is approved in fhir.ini.
evidence_items.learned: The Medication source folder is in current FHIR build scope for this audit.

evidence_items.summary: Current source defines Medication.status as 0..1 code with a required Medication Status binding, defines active/inactive/entered-in-error, and exposes a status search parameter.
evidence_items.learned: The current spec source already contains the status code surface requested by FHIR-5827.

evidence_items.summary: The 2017 git-svn patch added Medication.status, the MedicationStatus code list/binding, and active/inactive/entered-in-error codes to the then-authoritative Medication spreadsheet source.
evidence_items.learned: The Medication status work was applied historically even though no FHIR-5827-tagged implementation commit was found.

evidence_items.summary: Existing combined-branch audit for FHIR-12392 confirms the same Medication.status addition, non-formulary caveat, and status search parameter.
evidence_items.learned: The closely related status issue is already represented, so this seed should only audit FHIR-5827.

evidence_items.summary: Later Published FHIR-32482 changed Medication status value definitions from availability wording to record-currentness wording and is already fixed on the combined branch.
evidence_items.learned: Current wording differences from early availability language are intentional later decisions, not an unapplied FHIR-5827 defect.
